claimBoundary: Same-team post-result component tests; not a cryptographic proof or independent privacy review.

contentAddressing.interpretation: Object addressing detects byte substitution only while an expected digest remains authenticated; a fully re-authored manifest is a new artifact.

fidelityPropagation.interpretation: Ignoring known invalidity creates a false supported conclusion.

hashChain.interpretation: After an attacker recomputes package descriptors and the unsigned manifest digest, the stale event hash remains detectable.

limitations: The independent verifier is same-team code even though it imports no SOVA module.
Included-key validity is not external identity or non-repudiation.
Timestamp material was bound but deliberately not externally verified.
Disclosure commitments do not prove hidden plaintext truth or completeness.
Privacy usability, correlation, dictionary, and traffic-analysis attacks remain external work.
